description: Issue #839 (maintainer ruling #833 rule 3, "nothing shadows"): `define forward … print 1 … end` then `print fd`. The runtime phase-1 registration guard (`spec/execution-model.md:82-89`) raises `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/error-model.md:125`) at the declaration, so the procedure never runs and the event stream is empty — which is itself the strongest evidence the halt happens at registration rather than at the reporter position. Re-legalising `define forward` reddens this and leads the next reader to #787. The evaluator-level invariant is carried in `packages/runtime/src/heritage-alias-chokepoint.test.mjs`.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
